courses.overviewEn: Compare neighbouring instruments through transferable principles, measurements and validation; a link does not imply the same vendor, generation or acceptance requirements.

related.title: EUV 多層膜反射鏡
related.transfer: 可遷移「為何是錫、為何是 CO₂ 雷射」與「錫滴時序、位置量測與閉環導向」的建模、量測與誤差預算方法；EUV 多層膜反射鏡的元件、尺度與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The modelling, measurement and error-budget methods of "Why tin and why a CO₂ drive laser" and "Droplet timing, position metrology and closed-loop steering" transfer, while components, scales and acceptance conditions of EUV multilayer mirrors must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦雷射電漿錫滴光源的轉換效率、錫滴產生與定位、劑量穩定與集光鏡壽命；EUV 多層膜反射鏡則以13.5 nm 反射式光學的多層膜、面形、污染與波前預算為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on conversion efficiency, droplet generation and targeting, dose stability and collector lifetime of laser-produced-plasma tin sources; EUV multilayer mirrors centres on multilayer reflectance, figure, contamination and wavefront budgets for 13.5 nm reflective optics, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「錫電漿與 13.5 nm 頻帶」與「反射式光路與真空腔」的輸入、輸出與主要干擾。
把本課算例的一個假設移到EUV 多層膜反射鏡，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「波前誤差預算與 Strehl 判準」為例，設計一項能區分兩種系統的驗證量測，並註明不確定度。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the inputs, outputs and main disturbances of “Tin plasma and the 13.5 nm band” and “Reflective optical path and vacuum chamber”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to EUV multilayer mirrors, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Wavefront-error budget and the Strehl criterion", design a verification measurement that distinguishes the two systems and state its uncertainty.

related.transferEn: The modelling, measurement and error-budget methods of "Why tin and why a CO₂ drive laser" and "Droplet timing, position metrology and closed-loop steering" transfer, while components, scales and acceptance conditions of ASML lithography projection-optics engineering must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦雷射電漿錫滴光源的轉換效率、錫滴產生與定位、劑量穩定與集光鏡壽命；ASML 微影投影光學工程則以從 Rayleigh 解析度到折反射浸潤鏡頭的像差、熱漂移與套刻預算為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on conversion efficiency, droplet generation and targeting, dose stability and collector lifetime of laser-produced-plasma tin sources; ASML lithography projection-optics engineering centres on from Rayleigh resolution to aberration, thermal drift and overlay budgets of catadioptric immersion lenses, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「錫電漿與 13.5 nm 頻帶」與「投影鏡頭數值孔徑與像方空間」的輸入、輸出與主要干擾。
把本課算例的一個假設移到ASML 微影投影光學工程，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「鏡頭加熱、像差漂移與誤差預算」為例，設計一項能區分兩種系統的驗證量測，並註明不確定度。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the inputs, outputs and main disturbances of “Tin plasma and the 13.5 nm band” and “Projection-lens NA and image space”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to ASML lithography projection-optics engineering, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: EUV 光源錫滴控制概念
history.text: 雷射電漿 EUV 光源的工程化由聖地牙哥的 Cymer（1986 年成立，2013 年併入 ASML）與日本 Gigaphoton 在 2000 年代推動，TRUMPF 與 Cymer 合作把多級 CO₂ 放大器的平均功率推到數十千瓦；前脈衝靶形技術與氫氣清潔使 IF 功率從 2010 年代初的數十瓦提升到 2017 年前後的 250 W，之後持續朝 500 W 以上推進，支撐 NXE 系列進入量產。本課只重建公開文獻中的物理與工程邏輯。
history.textEn: Engineering of laser-produced-plasma EUV sources was driven in the 2000s by Cymer of San Diego (founded 1986, acquired by ASML in 2013) and by Gigaphoton in Japan, with TRUMPF and Cymer pushing multi-stage CO₂ amplifiers to tens of kilowatts of average power; pre-pulse target shaping and hydrogen cleaning raised IF power from tens of watts in the early 2010s to about 250 W around 2017 and onward toward 500 W and more, supporting NXE systems in volume production. This course reconstructs only the physics and engineering logic found in public literature.

history.title: 從工程史到可驗證模型
history.titleEn: From engineering history to verifiable models
history.text: 本課把「為何是錫、為何是 CO₂ 雷射」到「光源驗收、可用度與工程交接」改寫為 32 個原創分析、量測與診斷任務；不複製來源圖片、影片逐字稿或現場程序。
history.textEn: The course turns "Why tin and why a CO₂ drive laser" through "Source acceptance, availability and engineering handoff" into 32 original analysis, measurement and diagnosis tasks without copying source images, video transcripts or field procedures.
